decision: Measured from 2015-2025 nflverse weekly actuals (promotion_demotion_rates.py). Promotion = bench player (by season-to-date PPG rank) who becomes a starter by season end. Demotion = starter who falls to bench. Rates are per-week averages at mid-season (weeks 5-12) to avoid early-season noise and late-season compression.
note: These rates are used ONLY when the promotion_model flag is on (off by default). They modify the expected-starts lineup share to account for persistent role changes.

promotion_rate_per_remaining_week._comment: Probability that a bench player at this depth becomes a starter, per remaining week of season. Derived from the slope of the promotion-rate-by-week curve: rate(W) ~ base * (total_weeks - W) / total_weeks. The per-week rate is base / total_weeks.

demotion_rate_per_remaining_week._comment: Probability that a starter falls to bench, per remaining week. Used to reduce marginal starters' share symmetrically.
